published_prior_art.cite: shpitserpearl2008hierarchy and shpitser2023idfail give single-graph hedge/ID-failure characterizations, not bounded uncertain-edge sparse-core compilation.
akbari2022minimum, kobayashietal2022steiner, and kenigmizrahi2025transversals do not provide a projected cross-core partial-support extension oracle.
akbari2023uncertain optimizes one identifiable subgraph; kobayashietal2022steiner and kenigmizrahi2025transversals address different explicit-witness inputs.
shpitser2023idfail characterizes ID failure by original-query hedges, while khachiyanetal2007pathcut supplies path-enumeration machinery but not uncertain-label projection.
Generic monotone-event reliability/independence-polynomial identities are standard; the contribution is their causal-obstruction instantiation.
samerszeider2010modelcounting and dudekphanvardi2020dpmc already provide the bounded-incidence weighted-model-counting architecture.
provan1986acyclicreliability proves restricted acyclic reliability hardness, but not the width-two ADMG successful-realization counting reduction.

soundness_flags.label: symbols p/R/GradR and thm:reliability-polynomial
soundness_flags.one_line: p and R are declared only on rational inputs, but the theorem quantifies real p in (0,1)^E and asserts a polynomial extension; declare a real-cube reliability polynomial and reserve rationals for exact-arithmetic inputs.

soundness_flags.label: bibliography entry shpitser2023idfail
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited work is an arXiv note (arXiv:2307.03750), not a PMLR volume-206 publication; correct its venue/version everywhere it is invoked.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper models edge-induced ADMG subgraphs, assumes mutually independent edges for its main optimization setup, seeks a most-probable identifiable subgraph, and proves edge ID NP-complete.
The article gives complete identification methods for interventional distributions in recursive semi-Markovian models and defines the semi-Markovian model assumptions used by ordinary ID.
The note states that ID fails iff an original-query hedge exists and explains the correction to the earlier hedge criterion; the accessible primary version is arXiv, not PMLR 206.
The paper studies minimum-cost interventions to render a target causal effect identifiable, connecting the problem to hitting set and giving exact, approximation, and heuristic algorithms.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv preprint corresponding to PODS 2022 paper
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work gives a linear-delay, polynomial-space algorithm for minimal Steiner trees and extensions including directed variants.
The paper enumerates minimal hitting sets with fixed-parameter-linear delay after FPT preprocessing, parameterized by hypergraph treewidth.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Discrete Algorithms 8 (2010) author-hosted publication PDF
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper supplies fixed-parameter #SAT dynamic programming on a supplied incidence-treewidth decomposition, including bit-complexity analysis.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv preprint corresponding to CP 2020 paper
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: DPMC is an exact literal-weighted CNF model-counting framework based on project-join dynamic programming.

source_verification_receipts.version: Reliability Engineering and System Safety 193 (2020), Article 106665
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives an exact reliability algorithm for networks of small underlying treewidth.
Source--sink reliability is #P-complete even for acyclic directed planar graphs of maximum degree three.
The paper proves several reliability enumeration/counting problems #P-complete, including counting vertex covers in bipartite graphs.
The paper studies path/cut conjunction and disjunction enumeration and gives a polynomial-delay directed path-enumeration special case.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Separate a real-valued reliability polynomial R:[0,1]^E→[0,1] from the rational exact-arithmetic input encoding, and define GradR on the same real domain.
Replace the erroneous PMLR citation for shpitser2023idfail with arXiv:2307.03750 and add its Proposition 1 locator where original-query hedge equivalence is used.

Make “available bow” and the transition-DAG labels formal in the width-two definition, then include one nontrivial deterministic-diamond worked instance demonstrating unique uncertain-support projection.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two coherence defects, formalize the width-two projection vocabulary, then advance the field-tier enumeration kernel to Stage 0.
